1 - Global Poverty rates

Poverty
Progress in reducing global extreme poverty has slowed down

Since 2015, the pace of extreme poverty reduction has slowed down. At the current pace of progress, the goal of reducing extreme poverty below 3% by 2030 is out of reach.

Note: Poverty rates are reported for the $3.00, $4.20, and $8.30 per person per day poverty lines (expressed in 2021 PPP dollars). Poverty is projected after 2024 based on per capita GDP growth projections in the June 2026 Global Economic Prospects complemented by the April 2026 Macro Poverty Outlook and the World Economic Outlook. The black horizontal line indicates the World Bank Group’s target for 3% extreme poverty by 2030.
